name: @projexlight/sdk-sovereign
summary: Sovereign-cloud deployment substrate: per-region config (FedRAMP US-East / EU-GovCloud / DE-Sovereign), bundle release management with provenance attestation, cross-region leak monitor that fails the pipeline if any data crosses jurisdiction. The PRD's P8 sovereign variant — sits next to sdk-onprem but for managed-by-ProjexCloud sovereign regions vs. customer-managed air-gap.

events.name: sovereign.bundle.released.v1
events.description: Bundle released to a sovereign region with provenance attestation.

events.name: sovereign.attestation.verified.v1
events.description: Attestation chain verified at runtime; required before bundles execute.

events.name: sovereign.leak.detected.v1
events.description: Cross-region data leak detected; pipeline halt + ops page.

models.description: Per-region row: name, regulatory profile, allowed providers, attestation_key.
Per-release row: bundle_id, region, attestation, released_at.
Per-alert row: from_region, to_region, kind (event/data), severity.

hooks.name: configureRegion
hooks.description: Create / update a sovereign region's regulatory + provider config.

hooks.name: releaseBundle
hooks.description: Release a signed bundle to a sovereign region; signature chain enforced.

hooks.name: verifyAttestation
hooks.description: Runtime — verify the attestation chain before the bundle executes.

hooks.name: startLeakMonitor
hooks.description: Background monitor: probes outbound traffic for cross-region leaks; halts pipeline on detection.

scenarios.title: Configure the DE-Sovereign region
scenarios.when_to_use: New sovereign region brought up; configure regulatory profile + the allow-listed providers (e.g. only EU-hosted AI providers).
scenarios.expected_outcome: Region config row written; emits .region.configured.v1. Deployments to this region pin to the allow-list automatically.

scenarios.title: Release a signed bundle to FedRAMP US-East with provenance
scenarios.when_to_use: New release goes out to a sovereign region; the build pipeline signs + attests, the sovereign install verifies before executing.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Release row written; attestation chain stored. Emits .bundle.released.v1. Runtime verification happens on the sovereign side before execution.

scenarios.title: Sovereign install verifies attestation on startup
scenarios.when_to_use: Service starts; calls verifyAttestation against the bundle it's running. If the chain fails (unsigned bundle, untrusted signer), the service refuses to start.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Service refuses to boot on bad attestation. Emits .attestation.verified.v1 on success; ops paged on failure.

scenarios.title: Leak monitor detects cross-region event traffic → pipeline halt
scenarios.when_to_use: Background monitor sees an event from eu-de namespace heading to a us-east pool. Halt the pipeline + page sovereignty oncall.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Pipeline halted within sec; emits .leak.detected.v1. Sovereignty officer reviews + decides whether to release the hold.

scenarios.title: Reactive: vault key rotation triggers re-attestation
scenarios.when_to_use: vault.key.rotated.v1 fires; any bundle whose attestation chain references the rotated key needs re-verification against the new key.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Affected attestations re-verified or flagged for re-release. Audit chain reflects the cascade.

compliance_posture.notes: Per-region regulatory profile pins the providers + the data flows allowed for each. SLSA-3 provenance attestation enforced on every bundle release — refused if missing. Leak monitor is the pipeline-level data-residency safety net; fails closed (halts) on any cross-region event detected.
